newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia sees 97 budget at maximum 730 bln tolars.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia sees 97 budget at maximum 730 bln tolars.

text.p: The Slovenian government said on Thursday 1997 spending was expected to amount to a maximum 730 billion tolars ($4.5 million).
"I believe the budget will reach a maximum 730 billion tolars as we are trying to limit public spending," deputy prime minister Marjan Podobnik told a news conference.
He said the government was expected to debate the budget at its next session, which is expected to take place next week.
Last year government spending amounted to 597.5 billion tolars while government income was 613.8 billion.
